user.title: Connect to Seerr
user.description: Search and request movies and TV shows through a Seerr (or Overseerr/Jellyseerr) server.

data_description.url: For example http://192.168.1.10:5055. A bare host name or IP address uses http and port 5055.
data_description.api_key: In Seerr under Settings → General. Requests are made as the API key's user, usually the admin, and are approved automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Seerr API key rejected
reauth_confirm.description: {url} rejected the API key. Enter the current one from Settings → General.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the server.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the API key.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http or https URL or a host name.
error.not_seerr: The server answered, but not like a Seerr server.

abort.already_configured: This Seerr server is already configured.

search.name: Search
search.description: Searches movies and TV shows and returns each one's TMDB id, year and status (available, requested or not).

config_entry_id.name: Seerr server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Seerr server is set up.

query.name: Title
query.description: Movie or TV show title to look for.

media_type.name: Type
media_type.description: Only movies or only TV shows.

year.name: Year
year.description: Release year (first air year for TV).

request.name: Request
request.description: Requests a movie, or every season of a TV show, by title or TMDB id. Returns requested, already_available, already_requested, ambiguous with the options, or not_found.

config_entry_id.name: Seerr server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Seerr server is set up.

query.name: Title
query.description: Title to request. A title that matches more than one show or movie is not requested; add a type or year, or use the TMDB id.

media_type.name: Type
media_type.description: Only movies or only TV shows.

year.name: Year
year.description: Release year (first air year for TV).

tmdb_id.name: TMDB id
tmdb_id.description: Request this TMDB id instead of searching. Needs a type.

is_4k.name: 4K
is_4k.description: Request the 4K version, from the 4K Radarr or Sonarr server.

entry_not_found.message: No Seerr server with config entry id {entry_id}.

no_server.message: No Seerr server is set up and loaded.

pick_server.message: More than one Seerr server is set up; choose one.

ambiguous.message: "{query}" matches more than one title: {options}. Add a type or year, or use the TMDB id.
